nodes.title: director16: script walk v6.7 on int/r6 d955a9c7c (integration 20: Brain v6.7, Studio patch 018, Learning D10 register rewrite), run by main, 16 lessons, 1,472 calls ~$1.001, reply-ready per-lesson p50 median ~2.87 s; counted by hand by 4 Claude judges with the P4′ shape (a miss verdict naming the child's value on a remediation's page) counted for the first time: beats 256/267 (96%; c5-t02 e1 and c4 e3 points lost in all lessons), verdicts 263/263, misgrades 0/1 (c5-t01 stuck 63: '-1/7 km' graded right, the key match ignores the sign), false keys 0; contradictions 8 (paging 6, second view 2) vs director15 5 under the old rule (~25 under this rule); per topic c4 5, c5-t01 0, c5-t02 2, c6 1; P4′ 59/59, verdict-then-next-card paging 172/175, 0 asides lost (from 9). Register 3.5 in all four topics for the first time; c6 passes every judge axis; listening 3 in three topics; promises 3–3.5. Three mechanisms: an aside return or question silently pins the next card (3 contradictions, 13 turns), a Hindi request during a worked step gets the yourStep simpler on a closed board (3), the picture frame 'yahi numbers ab patti par' over a view without those numbers (2). H4 flagged 1 of 8.

The held board (reversal clause 1 taken, as written, unconditionally): the board follows the card. The screen shows the open card's board (its answer state while its close is spoken) and changes only where her words begin the next card's unit (a card plus the teaching leading into it: point+ask, worked example+yourStep, remediation+then-card, bridge+next first card), at most once per turn, at the start of that unit's first spoken part; code picks each unit's board from its card (no line-driven preselect); no card is on screen that she has not said and an unsaid card is never graded; a picture request draws its second view beside the held board (split at 360 px), its line built from the drawn view; Hindi, clarify, aside and 'sawaal kya hai' turns hold the board. Predicates throw in tests (≤1 change per turn, only at a spoken unit part, every spoken part's unit is the held board's, no grading of an unsaid card); the counter checks each part's unit against the held board on every turn. Learning (D11) makes each unit's spoken parts true of its card's board. Why: director16 had 8 paging + second-view contradictions by hand, over the clause's 5; the clause had been left untaken three times before; two of the three remaining mechanisms (the silently pinned card, a Hindi simpler on a closed card's board) are impossible under a held board. Reverse: director17's worked-example or class-level axis falls below 3.5 because a point or remediation lost its own picture → P4 paging returns, with the held rule kept for aside, Hindi, clarify and picture turns.

Script walk v6.8, beside the held board. Brain: A4 an aside question ends her turn with the next card neither posed nor pinned; the next turn acknowledges the child's answer in one code line (never graded), then says the card; G1 a sign mismatch is wrong, the grader audited against every scripted key (sign, units, equivalent forms) as a test matrix; V1″ the '?'-sentence drop applies to model sentences only, never authored lines (it removed D10's rhetorical points: c5-t02 e1 and c4 e3 lost in every lesson), the hook's model copy dropped on every path; B1‴ 'Ab se Hindi mein' followed by the live part's own hi text in different words, a worked step's own line during a worked example, a simpler spent on Hindi counts as spent, the greet's 'pata nahi' never carries into a later beat, a closed card never reopened; R5 check-ins 3–5 forms, a worked close says its why once, no 'Ab agla kadam' after a remediation, no doubled 'Pehla kadam… Pehle…', number agreement, 'aage chalo' never the stop menu. Studio: the held-board seam (unit boards from Brain, the second view beside the held board in a split at 360 px with no target under 44 px, the picture line from the drawn view). Learning: D11 units true of their card's board, no rhetorical '?' in non-card spoken fields, c5-t01 'naam hai, nishaan ka nahi' reworded, c5-t02 e2's ask board hides its answer, the '?'-over-stated-fraction lint fixed to catch c5-t02 steady 70–92, the leak rule relaxed to keys of all later cards plus distractors within the same skill only, with class-natural denominators. Why: director16 passes register everywhere and verdicts 100%, but listening fails in three topics, one wrong answer was called right, 11 beats were lost to the '?' drop, and the three contradiction mechanisms are runtime. Reverse: listening still below 3.5 with A4 and B1‴ in place → request handling moves to an explicit request × beat-kind table of code-defined response shapes; any misgrade → no paid run until the G1 key matrix passes; H5 misses more than 1 → the counter is retired as a gate input.

Dropping every '?' sentence outside the card on scripted turns (v6.6, say.js cardlessQ / noQ(body)) to stop model-written questions. It also removed authored text: Learning's D10 register rewrite added rhetorical questions to points ('Neeche ka 4? Patti ke 4 barabar tukde.', 'Neeche 3 kyun? Kyunki…'), and director16 lost c5-t02's e1 point and c4's e3 point in all 8 of those lessons. A guard aimed at one author's text must check who wrote the sentence, not its punctuation; v6.8 V1″ limits the drop to model sentences.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-held-board` (2026-11-09)

**Reversal clause 1 taken, as written.** The board follows the card.
- The screen shows the open card's board. It changes only where her words begin the next card's unit, at most once per turn.
- No card is on screen that she has not said.
- A picture's second view goes beside the held board.

**Why:** director16 had 8 paging plus second-view contradictions, over the clause's 5. The clause had been left untaken three times. Two of the three remaining mechanisms become impossible under a held board.

**Reverse if:** the worked-example or class-level axis falls below 3.5 because pictures were lost. Then P4 paging returns, and the held rule stays only for request turns.

## `dc-r7-script-walk-v6-8` (2026-11-09)

Beside the held board.

**Brain:**
- **A4:** an aside question ends her turn, with no silent card.
- **G1:** sign-aware grading, plus a key test matrix.
- **V1″:** the '?' drop applies to model text only.
- **B1‴:** Hindi requests.
- **R5:** code frames.

**Studio:** the held-board seam.

**Learning (D11):** units true of their card's board; a relaxed leak rule.

**Reverse if:**
- listening is still below 3.5: a request × beat-kind table;
- any misgrade: no paid run until the key matrix passes;
- the counter misses more than 1: it is retired as a gate input.
md.rejected:
## `rj-r7-question-drop-on-authored-text` (2026-11-09)

The tried approach: drop every '?' sentence outside the card on scripted turns (v6.6), to stop model-written questions.

**What broke:** it also removed authored rhetorical questions in points, added by Learning's register rewrite. director16 lost c5-t02's e1 point and c4's e3 point in all 8 of those lessons.

A guard aimed at one author's text must check who wrote the sentence, not its punctuation.
